initialExam.title: RRB Group D 2025-26
initialExam.description: Railway Group D (Level 1) recruitment for Track Maintainer, Helper, and other Group D posts. Notification out Jan 2026; exam expected Aug 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: 10th pass from a recognized Board + ITI (for some posts)
initialExam.syllabus: Mathematics (25Q), General Intelligence & Reasoning (30Q), General Science (25Q), General Awareness & Current Affairs (20Q).
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. PET: Lifting, carrying, running tests.
initialExam.selectionProcess: CBT → Physical Efficiency Test (PET) → Document Verification → Medical
initialExam.jobRole: Track Maintainer Grade IV, Helper in various departments, Pointsman, Gateman
initialExam.careerGrowth: Group D → Trackman → Gangman → Keyman → Mate through promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit rrbcdg.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Free Rail passes, Quarters, Medical, Pension
